newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-ICELANDERS STUN DINAMO BUCHAREST IN UEFA CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ICELANDERS STUN DINAMO BUCHAREST IN UEFA CUP.

text.p: Icelandic club KR Reykjavik, with only a handful of wins in European competition, knocked top Romanian side Dinamo Bucharest out of the UEFA Cup on Wednesday.
Reykjavik beat Dinamo 2-1 to win the first qualifying round 4-1 on aggregate. Rikhardur Dadasson, who also scored in the first leg, provided both goals in the first 22 minutes.
Seven thousand Dinamo fans chanted "Shame on you" at their team throughout the match. "We will have to hide away at home for a long time now," said defender Florin Batranu.

Dinamo boast a solid record in Europe, reaching the semifinals of the European Cup in 1983-84 where they lost to eventual winners Liverpool. They also reached the semifinals of the Cup winners' Cup in 1989-90.
Reykjavik, founded in 1899, have now won four out of their 25 European matches since 1964 with a goals record of 27-90.
"The game was exactly like we predicted", coach Haraldur Haraldsson said. "Dinamo played offensively under the huge pressure of having to score and forgot about defence." REUTER
